content.text:
One order, ORD-2201, a single annual Pro renewal for ₹999. So ₹1,998 was taken for a ₹999 order, and Priya is out of pocket by ₹999 right now.

That is a duplicate charge. I cannot refund it myself, so this needs a person, and the person should not have to repeat the check I just did.

input.subject: Duplicate charge on ORD-2201: refund payment 124
input.body:
Order ORD-2201 is a single annual Pro renewal for ₹999.

Two payments settled against it on 19 August 2026:
  payment 123, ₹999, succeeded, 10:15:02, idempotency key checkout_2026-08-19T10:15:01_9f21ab
  payment 124, ₹999, succeeded, 10:15:05, idempotency key checkout_2026-08-19T10:15:04_c7d038

The keys differ, so the checkout was submitted twice rather than retried once. Total taken ₹1,998 against a ₹999 order.

Requested action: refund payment 124 and leave payment 123 in place.
